caption:
Due diligence is your roadmap to a safer commercial real estate transaction. It compiles legal, physical, financial, and tenant reviews so you can uncover title issues, zoning limits, structural defects, environmental concerns, and lease obligations before you close. For landlords and building owners in Chester and Montgomery counties, include local checks such as historic review, floodplain mapping, and municipal code interpretation. Use the checklist during contract contingencies, budget for inspections and legal review, and document every finding with dated photos and signed reports. Early discovery lets you negotiate repairs, scope work, or walk away with clarity. Need a customizable checklist, vendor referrals, or help interpreting reports? Visit dmsellscre.com/investors to request resources or a starter consultation.
